notes: Fresh seed, same simulator distribution. No training or policy selection on test paths.
Gains include claim payoff, trading P&L and costs; no initial option premium is added.
Lower std and loss_cvar_95 are better for those risk metrics; higher empirical OCE is better.
Empirical OCE re-estimates only the scalar risk statistic for each strategy. Frozen-model utility uses the learned intercept; these are different estimators.
Spot delta uses only spot and observed implied volatility, zero rates, the same trade bounds/costs and settlement, and no option trades. It is a heuristic benchmark.
Original stochastic simulator evaluates the claim one dt after spot hedge settlement; this is preserved, and delta maturity includes that extra dt. BS mode has no offset.
Paths share the simulator's cross-sectional normalization. Metrics are descriptive; no iid confidence intervals or real-market profitability claims are provided.
Reusing this test to choose epochs/hyperparameters makes it validation; reserve a new seed for the final assessment after further tuning.
